'''July 2000 Wauwatosa tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Wauwatosa, WI on 26 July 2000. Eric won it. It is known from Chuck Sonnenburg's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1041">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-26-wauwatosa-wi-7-26-00d1041/ wauwatosa-wi-7-26-00], DeckTech (Chuck "Sonn" Sonnenburg, 26 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-26-wauwatosa-wi-7-26-00d1041/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Wauwatosa, WI
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' Eric
